clauses.title: Consideration & Entire Contract
clauses.source_text: This Policy, together with the Schedule of Benefits and approved Endorsements, constitutes the entire contract between the Company and the Insured.
clauses.reason: Legal contractual preamble; preserved for audit and legal reference.

clauses.title: Policy Inception & Effective Date
clauses.source_text: Insurance coverage takes effect at 12:01 A.M. standard time at the residence of the Insured on the Effective Date stated in the Schedule of Benefits. The policy remains in force until the stipulated Renewal Date, subject to the Grace Period.
clauses.reason: Temporal boundary: hospitalization must occur between Policy Inception Date and Policy Expiry Date (Rule R01).

clauses.title: Grace Period
clauses.source_text: A grace period of thirty-one (31) calendar days is granted for the payment of each renewal premium falling due after the initial premium.
clauses.reason: Administrative payment provision handled in billing subsystem.

clauses.title: Notice of Claim Timeline
clauses.source_text: Written notice of claim must be furnished to the Company within ten (10) calendar days from the commencement of hospital confinement or occurrence of loss.
clauses.reason: Deterministic timeline constraint: Submission Date - Hospitalization start date <= 10 days (Rule R15).

clauses.title: Insured Age Bounds
clauses.source_text: The eligible person named in the Schedule who has attained at least eighteen (18) years of age and not more than fifty-nine (59) years of age on the Effective Date of this Policy.
clauses.reason: Deterministic age eligibility constraint: 18 <= Patient Age <= 59 at inception, upper bound 65 for coverage (Rule R02).

clauses.title: In-Patient Confinement Minimum Duration
clauses.source_text: A person who is formally admitted to a licensed Hospital as a registered bed patient and continuously confined for a minimum duration of at least twenty-four (24) consecutive hours.
clauses.reason: Hospitalization days >= 1 (Discharge Date - Hospitalization start date >= 1) required for inpatient benefits (Rule R04).

clauses.title: Sickness Commencement
clauses.source_text: Any disease or pathological illness first manifested, contracted, and commencing after the active Coverage Commencement Date of this policy.
clauses.reason: Tied to the initial 31-day sickness waiting period (Rule R03).

clauses.title: Injury Definition
clauses.source_text: Accidental bodily trauma occurring while this policy is in force, effected solely and directly by external, violent, and accidental means evidenced by visible contusion or wound, independent of all other causes.
clauses.reason: Clinical definition; medical narrative checked via RAG citations.

clauses.title: Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
clauses.source_text: Any physical condition, disorder, or symptom for which medical advice, diagnosis, care, or treatment was received, or for which a physician was consulted at any time prior to the Effective Date or Reinstatement Date.
clauses.reason: General exclusion: conditions existing prior to inception are strictly excluded (Rule R10).

clauses.title: Hospital Definition & Licensing
clauses.source_text: An institution legally licensed as a hospital which operates primarily for the inpatient reception, care, and medical treatment of ailing or injured persons; maintains 24-hour graduate nursing services; has licensed physicians available at all times.
clauses.reason: Institutional qualification requirement preserved for RAG evidentiary grounding.

clauses.title: Medical Necessity Certification
clauses.source_text: Hospital confinement, care, or surgical procedure certified by the attending Physician confirming that safe and efficacious medical treatment could not have been provided on an outpatient basis.
clauses.reason: Physician clinical certification requirement preserved for cross-document reconciliation.

clauses.title: Age Expiration (65 Years)
clauses.source_text: Inpatient surgical expense and sickness hospitalization benefits terminate automatically when the Insured attains sixty-five (65) years of age.
clauses.reason: Upper bound termination at 65 years: Patient Age <= 65.

clauses.title: Room & Board Daily Limit
clauses.source_text: Eligible room and board charges are covered up to a daily limit equal to the lower of: (a) NPR 5,000 per day; or (b) 1.0% of the Hospitalization Sum Insured per day.
clauses.reason: Deterministic sub-limit: whichever is lower of 1% of Sum Insured and Amt(5,000) per day (Rule R05).

clauses.title: Intensive Care Unit (ICU) Sub-Limit
clauses.source_text: Medically necessary confinement in an Intensive Care Unit is covered up to a daily limit of NPR 10,000 per day.
clauses.reason: Deterministic sub-limit: NPR 10,000 per day for ICU confinement (Rule R06).

clauses.title: Maximum Confinement Period (364 Days)
clauses.source_text: Daily hospital income or confinement indemnity is payable for a maximum aggregate duration of fifty-two (52) weeks (364 calendar days) per policy year.
clauses.reason: Days confined <= 364 per policy year.

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Major Cardiac & Neuro (100% / NPR 200,000)
clauses.source_text: Coronary Artery Bypass / Open Heart Surgery (100.0%, Payable Ceiling NPR 200,000); Craniotomy (Cutting into cranial cavity) (100.0%, Payable Ceiling NPR 200,000).
clauses.reason: Deterministic procedure reimbursement limit: NPR 200,000 per procedure (Rule R07).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Major Resections (75% / NPR 150,000)
clauses.source_text: Radical Mastectomy / Thyroidectomy (Goiter) (75.0%, NPR 150,000); Laminectomy / Resection of Stomach or Bowel (75.0%, NPR 150,000).
clauses.reason: Deterministic procedure reimbursement limit: NPR 150,000 per procedure (Rule R07).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Hysterectomy (62.5% / NPR 125,000)
clauses.source_text: Hysterectomy (Radical or with oophorectomy) (62.5%, NPR 125,000).
clauses.reason: Deterministic procedure reimbursement limit: NPR 125,000 per procedure (Rule R07).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Cataract & Mastoidectomy (50% / NPR 100,000)
clauses.source_text: Cataract Extraction / Radical Mastoidectomy (50.0%, NPR 100,000).
clauses.reason: Deterministic procedure reimbursement limit: NPR 100,000 per procedure (Rule R07).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Hernia Repair & Appendectomy
clauses.source_text: Single Hernia Repair (Radical) (37.5%, NPR 75,000); Appendectomy (25.0%, NPR 50,000).
clauses.reason: Deterministic procedure reimbursement limits: NPR 75,000 and NPR 50,000 respectively (Rule R07).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Diagnostic Endoscopy / Bronchoscopy
clauses.source_text: Diagnostic / Operative Bronchoscopy or Endoscopy (12.5%, NPR 25,000).
clauses.reason: Deterministic procedure reimbursement limit: NPR 25,000 per procedure (Rule R07).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Schedule — Obstetrical Procedures (Excluded / NPR 0)
clauses.source_text: OBSTETRICAL PROCEDURES (Cesarean / Delivery) (0.0% None, Excluded NPR 0).
clauses.reason: Strict exclusion of obstetrical and maternity procedures with 0% benefit (Rule R13).

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Surgical Session Rule & Frequency Limits
clauses.source_text: If multiple surgical procedures are performed during the same operative session, the indemnity payable shall be restricted solely to the highest percentage applicable. Benefit in respect of any covered surgical procedure is payable only once during any single Policy Year.
clauses.reason: Multi-procedure session rule restricted to highest percentage; handled in claim aggregation.

clauses.section: Part V — In-Hospital Surgical Expense Benefits
clauses.title: Annual Surgical Aggregate Ceiling (NPR 400,000)
clauses.source_text: Total surgical indemnities paid within any single Policy Year shall not exceed two hundred percent (200% / double) of the Maximum Surgical Benefit (NPR 400,000).
clauses.reason: Annual cumulative cap: total surgical claims paid <= NPR 400,000 (Rule R08).

clauses.title: Initial Sickness 31-Day Waiting Period
clauses.source_text: Coverage for Sickness becomes effective on the thirty-first (31st) day following the Policy Effective Date or Reinstatement Date. No benefits are payable for any illness contracted or manifested during the initial 30 days. Accidental injuries carry zero (0) waiting days.
clauses.reason: Hospitalization start date - Policy inception Date >= 30 days for sickness, 0 days for accident (Rule R03).

clauses.title: Specific Named Ailments 120-Day Waiting Period
clauses.source_text: Hospital confinement or surgical treatment for tonsils, adenoids, hernia, or intervertebral disc disease is excluded until the Insured has been continuously covered under this policy for at least one hundred twenty (120) days immediately preceding confinement.
clauses.reason: Deterministic 120-day waiting period condition for specific named surgical ailments (Rule R09).

clauses.title: Confinement Elimination Period (First 24 Hours)
clauses.source_text: The first one (1) day (24 hours) of hospital confinement due to Sickness constitutes an Elimination Period for which daily benefit is not payable.
clauses.reason: Deduction of first 24 hours of confinement for daily cash benefit calculation.

clauses.title: Cosmetic & Plastic Surgery Carve-Out
clauses.source_text: Cosmetic or plastic surgery is excluded, except when necessitated solely by an Accidental Bodily Injury occurring while this policy is in force.
clauses.reason: Excluded unless Admission Reason is Accident (Rule R11).

clauses.title: Dental Care & Surgery Carve-Out
clauses.source_text: Dental care, fillings, or oral surgery are excluded, except when treatment is required for damage to sound natural teeth caused directly by an Accidental Bodily Injury.
clauses.reason: Excluded unless Admission Reason is Accident (Rule R12).

clauses.title: Maternity & Obstetrical Care Exclusion
clauses.source_text: Hospital confinement or surgical treatment resulting directly or indirectly from pregnancy, childbirth, miscarriage, abortion, or related complications is excluded. The obstetrical schedule percentage is explicitly None (0%).
clauses.reason: Absolute exclusion of maternity and obstetrical care (Rule R13).

clauses.title: Hazardous Sports & Alternative Medicine Exclusion
clauses.source_text: Excluded are injuries sustained during competitive racing, mountaineering, potholing, paragliding, bungee jumping, parachuting, scuba diving; stays in sanatoriums; and treatments in Ayurvedic, herbal, or acupuncture facilities.
clauses.reason: General exclusion for hazardous sports and unapproved alternative therapies.

clauses.section: Part VIII — Accident Medical Expense & Coordination
clauses.title: Accident Medical Expense Deductible (NPR 500) & Cap (NPR 50,000)
clauses.source_text: Accident medical expense reimbursement is subject to a deductible of NPR 500 per claim. The Company reimburses eligible expenses in excess of NPR 500 up to NPR 50,000.
clauses.reason: HIPML ANTLR grammar defines copay % on policy attributes but does not have a dedicated flat deductible token; applied deterministically at claim settlement layer (Rule R14).

clauses.section: Part VIII — Accident Medical Expense & Coordination
clauses.title: Non-Duplication of Benefits
clauses.source_text: If the Insured is entitled to reimbursement under any statutory scheme or other insurance, the Company is liable only for the excess non-reimbursed reasonable charges.
clauses.reason: Subrogation and coordination of benefits legal clause.

clauses.section: Part IX — Schedule of Policy Specifications
clauses.title: MVP Baseline Benefit Parameters
clauses.source_text: Hospitalization Sum Insured: NPR 500,000; Daily Room & Board Limit: Lesser of 1% SI or NPR 5,000; ICU Limit: NPR 10,000; Max Surgical Benefit: NPR 200,000; Annual Surgical Aggregate: NPR 400,000; Accident Limit: NPR 50,000; Deductible: NPR 500.
clauses.reason: Constitutes the core benchmark numerical parameters codified into HIPML.
